description: This PHP class `LeaveBalanceWithLeavePeriod` serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It encapsulates the leave balance information along with an optional leave period, providing getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceWithLeavePeriod
classes.description: A DTO representing a user's leave balance together with an optional associated leave period.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize LeaveBalance and optional LeavePeriod.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Returns the LeavePeriod object or null.

methods.name: setLeavePeriod
methods.description: Sets the LeavePeriod object or null.
